description: Rail Vehicle Positioning Data Set: Lucy, October 2018 is a data set deposited in TUdatalib by its authors Hanno Winter. Key facts Fields of application: railway positioning, sensor fusion, sensor models Available data: 2x GNSS, 1x IMU Rail-track characteristics: ≈120 km on conventional and secondary line (tight curves, steep slopes, forested embankment) Available reference data: Open GNSS/IMU EKF-fusion solution (loosely coupled), high precision 3D track-map Structure: This data set follows the data sharing principles of ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
